title: SEOYUN: Refusal-Inducing Exam Documents for AI-Glasses Pipelines
abstract: arXiv:2611.26033v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Camera-equipped glasses can convert an examination page into a query to a vision-language model (VLM). Device detection addresses possession; a complementary question is whether an examination document can reduce the usefulness of an unauthorized capture. We present SEOYUN, an application-specific framework for refusal-inducing exam documents, with optical and encoder-level interventions as extensions. We use reverse jailbreaking to describe the direction of the objective: inducing abstention rather than bypassing refusal. Refusal induction and defensive visual prompt injection already have precedents; our contribution is a threat model, analytical limits, and an evaluation protocol for examination use. We distinguish refusal from correct-answer leakage, show why removing an added dummy option is not itself a reduction in the original answer space, and derive a sampling comparison under explicitly stated camera assumptions. translated_title: SEOYUN：面向AI眼镜管线的拒答诱导型考试文档
translated_abstract: 配备摄像头的眼镜可以将考试页面转换成对视觉语言模型（VLM）的查询。设备检测针对的是持有行为；一个互补的问题是考试文档本身是否能够降低未经授权拍摄的有用性。我们提出了SEOYUN，这是一个面向拒答诱导型考试文档的应用专用框架，并以光学层面和编码器层面的干预作为扩展。我们使用“反向越狱”来描述该目标的方向：诱导模型弃答而非绕过拒答机制。拒答诱导和防御性视觉提示注入已有先例；我们的贡献在于威胁模型、分析性限制以及面向考试场景的评估协议。我们区分了拒答与正确答案泄露，说明了为什么移除一个附加的干扰选项本身并不构成对原始答案空间的缩减，并在明确声明的摄像头假设下推导出一种抽样比较。该协议……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SEOYUN框架，通过设计能诱导视觉语言模型主动弃答的考试文档来防御AI眼镜作弊，其核心贡献是针对考试场景的威胁模型、分析性限制与评估协议。
en_tdlr: The paper presents SEOYUN, an application-specific framework for designing exam documents that induce vision-language models to abstain from answering, contributing a threat model, analytical limits, and an evaluation protocol for examination use.
